note: Integrator review findings; final validation and resolution evidence are pending.

findings.finding: Initial helper signatures used task-route Buffer for std.buffer byte storage, conflating distinct resource models.
findings.resolution: Use own<bytes>/borrow<bytes>/lend<bytes>; refuse task Buffer on the helper route and test the distinction.

findings.finding: A closed entry observation alone cannot justify helpers for arbitrary resource arguments.
findings.resolution: Derive per-helper extent obligations and check every instantiated call; explicitly refuse uncalled helpers in this bounded closed profile and retain effect/custody checks.

findings.finding: Legacy qcore_acquire establishes ResourceId custody without a nominal payload type, so accepting a claimed own<T> annotation would invent typing evidence.
findings.resolution: Reject explicit acquisition annotations until the operation publishes a nominal type; keep inferred custody unchanged.
findings.status: implemented at b91cea0d; full validation pending

findings.finding: The initial public bound-certificate wrapper compared stored trust identity with expected identity without rederiving it from the presented certificate's contracts, allowing stale wrapper trust after coherent certificate substitution.
findings.resolution: Recompute contract/trust binding at admission, check profile identity against compile-task dependency identity, and test coherent valid-certificate substitution with retained old wrapper trust.
